messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay.iyer@novahealth.com>; Priya Shah <priya.shah@novahealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 07 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call exec recap: NovaHealth discovery & procurement path

Hi Sanjay / Priya, thanks again for your time today. Quick executive recap from our discovery to capture the business outcomes, risks, and next steps for procurement. Please tell me if I missed anything.

Key pain points you shared:
- Current triage and prior-authorization process is manual and siloed; average turnaround is 48-72 hours, causing delays and denials.
- High operational cost from RNs and external review teams; volume spikes create backlog and overtime.
- Lack of auditability / poor logs for decision rationale (audit risk for payor reviews).

Outcomes you care about:
- Reduce average triage time from ~60 hours to under 8 hours for urgent cases.
- 30%+ reduction in manual review headcount through automation and routing.
- Full audit trail for decisions to satisfy compliance and payer audits.

Technical/constraints noted:
- PHI must remain in your VPC; any pilot needs to run in NovaHealth's cloud region with KMS integration.
- Existing models run on CPU-only instances; you prefer a rollout that starts with a non-production integration for human-in-the-loop checks.

Procurement path & risk/escations:
- Current procurement owner: Priya Shah (legal & procurement).
- Target decision committee: CTO (Sanjay), Head of Ops (unnamed), and Finance.
- Risk: SOC2 attestation and Data Processing Agreement (DPA) required before pilot.
- Escalation: if we can provide SOC2 report and a limited-scope pilot contract within 3 weeks, Sanjay can push to Finance for early approval.

Proposed next steps (owners & timeline):
1) Marissa to share SOC2 evidence + SOC2 questionnaire answers and a short SOW draft by EOD tomorrow (Attachments: SOC2-Checklist.xlsx, NovaHealth-SOW-Reqs.pdf). (Owner: Marissa)
2) Technical kickoff (non-prod) with NovaHealth infra team to validate VPC/KMS integration — schedule week of Apr 18. (Owner: Aditya)
3) Pilot success criteria doc (reduce triage time to <8h for urgent cases; sample size 500 events) — draft by Apr 14. (Owner: Laura)
4) Pricing/contract discussion with procurement once SOC2/DPA confirmed — target closure by end of May. (Owner: Priya / Redwood sales)

If that looks right, can Priya confirm procurement contacts and preferred contracting timeline? Sanjay — please confirm the decision committee and any other compliance gatekeepers we should loop in.

Thanks again — excited to help NovaHealth move this quickly.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
